entries.title: Titus 2:1
segments: But do you, on your part, speak what becomes sound teaching;

entries.title: Titus 2:2
segments: that the older men be self-controlled, serious and sober-minded, sound in faith, in love, in patience;

entries.title: Titus 2:3
segments: that older women likewise be reverent in demeanor, not slanderers or slaves to much wine, but teachers of what is right.

entries.title: Titus 2:4
segments: They should train the younger women to love their husbands and children,

entries.title: Titus 2:5
segments: to be sober-minded, chaste, workers at home, kind and submissive to their husbands, in order that God's message be not maligned.

entries.title: Titus 2:6
segments: The younger men exhort to be sober-minded; in every respect showing yourself an example of good works.

entries.title: Titus 2:7
segments: In your teaching be serious and sincere.

entries.title: Titus 2:8
segments: Let the instruction that you give be sound and above reproach, so that our opponents may be ashamed because they find no evil things to say about us.

entries.title: Titus 2:9
segments: Exhort slaves to be obedient to their own masters, and to be well-pleasing to them in every respect;

entries.title: Titus 2:10
segments: not to contradict nor pilfer, but to exhibit praiseworthy trustworthiness in every thing, that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.

entries.title: Titus 2:11
segments: "For God's grace has shined forth bringing salvation to all men

entries.title: Titus 2:12
segments: And schooling us to renounce impiety and evil passions, And to live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age;

entries.title: Titus 2:13
segments: While we look for the blessed hope and epiphany of the glory of our great God and Saviour, Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Titus 2:14
segments: He gave himself for us to redeem us from all iniquity, and to purify unto himself a people zealous of good works."

entries.title: Titus 2:15
segments: Thus speak, exhort, reprove with all authority. Let no one despise you.
